faces._role: external input face. Beam enters along +z.
external transmit exit face (longpass: lambda > cutoff exits here along +z).
external reflect exit face (lambda < cutoff exits here along +x, 90 deg deflection).
INTERNAL dichroic coating at 45 deg (xz diagonal). Real surface normal (-0.7071, 0, 0.7071). Mirror reflect: k=+z -> k=+x (toward Br).

transitions._note: lambda > 650 nm passes straight through (+z), power *= T(lambda).
lambda < 650 nm reflects off B1 to +x exit, power *= (1 - T(lambda)).

notes.convention: Longpass: lambda > 650 nm transmits to Bt, lambda < 650 nm reflects to Br. T(lambda) split with sigmoid transition over 10 nm.
notes.geometry: Modeled as a 25 mm cube envelope with internal 45 deg coating B1. Real DMLP650 is a 1.05 mm thin plate at 45 deg in the mount. Aperture 11 mm = clear opening.
notes.reflectGeometry: B1 normal (-0.7071, 0, 0.7071). Mirror reflect of beam (0,0,1) gives k_out = (1, 0, 0) toward Br at +x.
